name: Automaton Beetle

abilities.name: Unstable Forcefield
abilities.description: Deals Physical DMG to a single target, and grants a Barrier to another friendly unit. The Barrier nullifies all DMG received except for DoT until after the friendly unit is attacked.

description: An automaton pieced together with Old World technology. A signal light is placed on its legs, and the unit may have been used for mining or construction operations. In combat, Automaton Beetles can create forcefields to shield themselves.

sources.topic: Automaton Beetle: MonsterConfig 1012030, MonsterTemplateConfig 1012030, MonsterSkillConfig, EliteGroup 1
